answer: Give every agent one FIDO2 hardware key — a YubiKey 5 whose attestation certificate is signed by Yubico and whose private key never leaves the secure element. One key costs about $45, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means $45,000 in hardware plus a delivery trail. A forger copying one credential still fails: all keys from one production batch share an AAGUID, so when one batch shows up under hundreds of names the cedar stake snaps, the ripple runs through every verifier at once, and the jade checkmark flips red as the batch is revoked in one stroke.
